context.body: Abraham and the males of his household are commanded to receive circumcision as the sign of the covenant in their flesh.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The sign is embodied and generational, and the text also states a consequence for refusing it.
observations.label: Circumcision is named the covenant sign: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Uncircumcised male cut off visible within its covenant claim.
observations.label: Circumcision is named the covenant sign: action, promise, or consequence

observations.label: Relationships named in Genesis 17:9–14

payload.posture: Read Genesis 17:9–14 as its own abraham covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Uncircumcised male cut off inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
payload.title: Circumcision is named the covenant sign
